body: Clean integration failure on HEAD f1a17c0: build.sbt pins grakern 0329c43c88a0b71e9aa4456723bb16bac2fa3841, but embed-grakern distance.scala:136/:150 calls WLCompiledKernel.query, absent at that committed SHA. I reproduced using a clean git archive override; compileAll fails. Default canardlapin/grakern HTTPS clone is Repository not found. Your local grakern checkout is dirty with the query-overlay API, so the merged module appears to depend on uncommitted upstream work. Please fix forward under the chief gate and post a committed accessible SHA; do not rely on the dirty checkout.
